missing_positive_ready.cause: These methods have source bodies, but every generated row for them has been source/version blocked. This is a selection-policy gap, not a missing-code-resource gap.

d4_or_workflow_level.cause: The current audit counts D4 only when the method is the row symbol. For leaf/callee methods this overstates the gap because bottom-up coverage should also count known_callees inside caller D4 rows.
d4_or_workflow_level.missing_resource: audit metric needs callee-propagation coverage; remaining true gaps need incoming caller/workflow rows or richer static call extraction

missing_callee_negative_edges.cause: The generator creates transit negatives by rotating modes, not by reading uncovered edges. Single-callee callers especially require explicit empty-transit negative rows.
missing_callee_negative_edges.missing_resource: targeted empty-transit negatives for single-callee callers and targeted partial-transit negatives for multi-callee callers
